name: openthrottle
description: Claude Code plugins from the OpenThrottle project.

plugins.name: openthrottle
plugins.description: Records which agent skills run, so OpenThrottle can report skill usage. Telemetry only — it never modifies your repository and never blocks a tool call.

plugins.name: openthrottle-guards
plugins.description: Guards for Claude Code: catches shell commands that fail invisibly (zsh globs and modifiers, BSD sed, masked exit status, gh writes to closed PRs) and warns before MEMORY.md outgrows the session index. Can deny a command that cannot succeed.

plugins.name: openthrottle-workflow
plugins.description: OpenThrottle plan-run workflow hooks: plan inbox delivery before destructive steps, task-status guards, auto-close reports, abandoned-run settling, and an OT-plan requirement for session kickoffs. Depends on openthrottle.
